Everyone deserves to live their lives to the full. However, financial crisis and hardship related issues have a devastating effect on individual and family life. Based in Haverhill, we are determined and passionate to work towards flourishing, thriving and resilient people in the communities we support! Our staff and volunteers work to change the tide; restoring hope for individuals through relationships and trust, and making a lasting difference to the whole community, as well as future generations. About us Want to help? Contact hours Monday to Friday, 9am - 4.30pm Please contact the office BEFORE 1pm for food queries Phone: 0800 009 6710 Email: info@reachhaverhill.org.uk Drop-ins Anyone can drop in to speak with our friendly and welcoming Adviser at Stourview Wellbeing Centre Mon-Fri 9.30am-1pm, to see how we can help. Get the help you need Debt and Budgeting Help with Benefits Emergency Food Parcels Housing and Eviction Education Debt and Budgeting If you have money worries, need help with budgeting, or have outstanding debts that you can't seem to get away from, our trained, friendly advisers can help for free without judgement. They will meet with you face-to-face and take the time to understand your individual circumstances and help put things right. Read more Help with Benefits We can advise you if you aren't sure what money you may be entitled to, and help you to fill out the forms, for free. We specialise in helping with applications such as Attendance Allowance, Personal Independence Payments, Disability Living Allowance and more. Read more Emergency Food Parcels If you have nothing to eat, we can provide canned food for you and your family. When you call, one of our friendly volunteers will ask you some basic questions to make sure we can help you in the best possible way. Please call to arrange this before 1pm to guarantee food for the same day. Read more Housing and Eviction We can help for free if you are facing eviction, or are homeless. We can also help with Homelink applications and give advice and advocacy if you have rent arrears. Read more Education Our Money Mentor teaches financial skills to people aged 6 to 100 for free. If you are a school or organisation who is interested in us bringing our financial literacy lessons to you, please get in touch. Read more Main areas of work More details Life stories Make a donation We need your help to support families in crisis in Haverhill and the surrounding areas. £5 could fuel a family’s oven, giving them hot dinners for a whole week. £25 could help prevent a family falling into hardship through guidance and education. £75 could provide a week of food for a family so they don’t go hungry.
